# OVO

Three independent open-source tools for product teams.

- [Askovo](https://github.com/roy-tong/Askovo) helps researchers and product managers connect decisions to user evidence, counterexamples and later reviews.
- [Growovo](https://github.com/roy-tong/Growovo) helps maintainers and small teams carry out authorized growth work, track replies and distinguish execution receipts from first use.
- [Verovo](https://github.com/roy-tong/Verovo) helps engineers and buyers reconcile AI charges against usage records and compare costs for accepted tasks.

## Explore

- [English](https://roy-tong.github.io/ovo/en.html) · [中文](https://roy-tong.github.io/ovo/)
- [Cases and interactive sample demos](https://roy-tong.github.io/ovo/en-cases.html)
- [Run a local prerelease demo](https://roy-tong.github.io/ovo/en-start.html)
- [Engineering journal](https://roy-tong.github.io/ovo/en-journal.html)

Case studies cite their public sources. Browser interactions use synthetic data. The quickstart runs the corresponding product locally.
